subject: Request: example case for list/detail with updates and mysql

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Request: example case for list/detail with updates and mysql
parts:
Hi,

  It would be great if you guys could provide a standard example where shiny attaches to a mysql database, shows a table with the rows (in e.g. the sidebar) and the currently selected detail view in the main view.  edits to the main view would be saved immediately or after an action button was pressed.  If no save occurs with the action button, focus changes would prompt the user to save or discard.

-Alex
